title: Consultor SAP FI/CO
description:
Consultor SAP FI/CO – Projeto Global | Remoto

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP FI/CO com experiência sólida em ambientes internacionais para atuar em um projeto global.


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Brasil)

Idioma: Inglês avançado (uso frequente em reuniões e interações)

Disponibilidade: Atuação em horário alinhado ao fuso dos EUA (com sobreposição de jornada)


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar e resolver tickets relacionados às operações diárias dos usuários
  • Atuar na análise, desenho, configuração e testes de melhorias de baixa complexidade
  • Suportar testes de usuário (UAT), orientando processos e fluxos funcionais
  • Avaliar customizações existentes quando necessário
  • Participar de reuniões com times globais e stakeholders

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com SAP FI/CO (mínimo de 7 anos)
  • Forte atuação em configuração e resolução de problemas
  • Experiência em projetos ou suporte internacionais/globais
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times distribuídos

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP ECC e/ou SAP S/4HANA
  • Vivência em ambientes multiculturais



Envie seu CV em inglês ou perfil atualizado para avaliação.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: Long Term

Type: PJ


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and SQL
  • Lead migration of Adobe-based pipelines to GCP/BigQuery
  • Develop event-driven ingestion pipelines for large-scale data processing
  • Integrate and transform datasets (including media/streaming data) into data warehouses
  • Manage and orchestrate workflows using Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reconciliation across pipelines
  • Optimize BigQuery performance, storage, and cost efficiency
  • Work across hybrid cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Snowflake)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data solutions
  • Maintain clear technical documentation and best practices


Required Skills & Experience

  • 7–9 years of hands-on experience in data engineering

Strong expertise in:

  • Python (data pipelines, scripting, transformation)
  • SQL (advanced queries, performance tuning)
  • Apache Airflow (DAGs, scheduling, orchestration)
  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP) & BigQuery
  • Cloud Composer (managed Airflow)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and automation workflows

Strong understanding of:

  • Data warehousing (star schema, dimensional modeling)
  • ETL/ELT architecture
  • Data quality frameworks and validation techniques


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Adobe Analytics / Adobe Experience Platform
  • Exposure to AWS and Snowflake in multi-cloud environments
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery cost optimization
  • Knowledge of media, streaming, or event-based data pipelines

title: Analista SAP ABAP
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional Sênior em SAP ABAP para atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de soluções, com foco em projetos complexos e ambientes modernos.

Essa pessoa será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento técnico, garantindo qualidade, performance e boas práticas, além de atuar na definição de arquitetura e apoio ao time.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver soluções complexas em ABAP (RICEFW);
  • Atuar com tecnologias modernas como SAP HANA (CDS, AMDP) e OData;
  • Definir padrões técnicos e realizar code review;
  • Desenvolver integrações (SAP PI/PO ou Integration Suite/BTP);
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time (mentoria);
  • Atuar em troubleshooting e incidentes críticos.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida com ABAP;
  • Vivência com S/4HANA;

title: Executivo Comercial Tributário
description:
Requisitos:

Superior completo em administração, direito, ciências contábeis, engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

Sólida experiência em gestão comercial;

Experiência como líder de equipe comercial;

Experiência em tributos;

Pacote Office avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Vender;

Gerir o processo de venda;

Supervisionar e direcionar a equipe para o alcance das metas;

Mapeamento das atividades e acompanhamento do cumprimento das tarefas no prazo estabelecido;

Gestão do relacionamento comercial nos grupos e meios de comunicação da empresa;

Controle de KPIs do setor;

Confecção de relatórios de performance da área para reporte a diretoria;

Implantação de melhorias e estratégias para o crescimento da área comercial alinhados aos objetivos da empresa.

Desejável:

Experiência no setor de comércio, em especial segmento automotivo e supermercadista

Perfil Comportamental Esperado

Buscamos profissionais que demonstrem organização, atenção aos detalhes e senso de responsabilidade, com resiliência para lidar com prazos e demandas simultâneas. É fundamental possuir maturidade profissional, com disciplina, proatividade, perfil hands on e foco em resultados. Valorizamos o alinhamento do discurso com a prática.


Benefícios:

Remuneração a combinar

Possibilidade de ingresso na sociedade

Plano de saúde (50%)

Seguro de vida sem custo

Previdência privada

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC).


Primary Job Duties:

  • Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time.
  • Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work.
  • Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision.
  • Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows
  • Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design.
  • Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures.
  • Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings.
  • Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis.
  • Improve system reliability through automation and observability.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.g., Git).
  • Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly.
  • Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required.
  • Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role.

  • Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity.
  • AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer.
  • Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems.
  • Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly.
  • Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.


This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Revel Street LLC helps corporate event planners discover and reach private dining venues through an extensive, dependable database. We use LLMs extensively to gather and enrich venue data, streamline the event planning workflow, and reduce the time and effort required to source options for events such as private dining, cocktail receptions, and conferences. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to help us improve data quality, fix existing data issues, and ingest more data from APIs and LLM-based sources to complement our current datasets. Our current stack includes React, TanStack, Cloudflare, Django, and Dagster, and we expect you to design solutions that are scalable, testable, and grounded in core engineering fundamentals.

Responsibilities

You’ll proactively turn ambiguous requirements into well-structured engineering plans. You’ll communicate trade-offs and risks early, and you’ll verify outcomes through hands-on testing. You’ll bring a “build, measure, improve” mindset to performance, reliability, and user experience.

  • Design, build, and maintain dbt pipelines for our analytics and operational workloads
  • Build and maintain ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from multiple APIs and other external sources
  • Set up and manage workflows in orchestration platforms such as Dagster
  • Develop and refine our data models to support analytics, reporting, and downstream products
  • Diagnose and fix data quality issues (duplicates, missing fields, inconsistent formats, incorrect mappings, etc.)
  • Implement robust data cleaning and validation checks
  • Integrate LLM-based data enrichment (e.g., using OpenAI or similar APIs) to improve and complement event data
  • Collaborate with our product and ops team to understand data needs and translate them into technical solutions

Requirements

  • Very high English proficiency (clear communication, strong writing, and the ability to collaborate effectively)
  • At least 3 years of data engineering experience including experience with dbt and the modern data stack
  • Some experience with devops, CI/CD, and database management.
  • At least 6 months of experience working exclusively in an agentic coding environment (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)
  • Ability to understand data engineering fundamentals, not just generate code—debugging, reasoning about behavior, and ensuring correctness
  • Some technical college degree

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) + DevOp:

Localização: Remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional SRE com habilidades em DevOps para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, disponibilidade e desempenho das nossas aplicações e infraestrutura. Este profissional atuará em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para promover uma cultura de automação e melhoria contínua.


Responsabilidades:

- Garantir a disponibilidade e a performance das aplicações e serviços, monitorando métricas e implementando soluções proativas.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para criar e implementar práticas de DevOps, como CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua).

- Automatizar processos de infraestrutura utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares.

- Implementar e gerenciar ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (como Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, etc.).

- Responder a incidentes e realizar análises de causa raiz para melhorar a confiabilidade do sistema.

- Participar da definição e implementação de políticas de segurança e conformidade.

- Ajudar na gestão de infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e configurações de infraestrutura.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em práticas de SRE e DevOps.

- Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e scripts (Python, Go, Bash, etc.).

- Experiência com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura (Terraform, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, etc.).

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.).

- Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Habilidade em solucionar problemas e trabalhar de forma independente.

- Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em gestão de incidentes e resposta a emergências.

- Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

- Certificações relevantes (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer, etc.).

- Familiaridade com práticas de segurança em DevOps (DevSecOps).

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Data Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required |


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


About the Role

The Data Engineering team is a software-centric group responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems that power a large marketplace platform. We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer who can take ownership of end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy role that goes beyond traditional data engineering, requiring strong architectural design and the ability to build robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, in addition to scalable data pipelines.

You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product, and Core Engineering teams to develop cutting-edge solutions that enhance the company’s data platform capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop code-driven interfaces between the data platform and internal/external services
  • Own projects from requirements gathering through production deployment and monitoring
  • Build scalable data transformations using dbt
  • Design systems that balance technical excellence with business needs, focusing on reliability and maintainability
  • Leverage AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to improve development speed and code quality
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, and Analytics teams to solve complex data challenges


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering with a strong foundation in system design
  • Strong programming skills with the ability to write production-grade, modular Python code
  • Expert-level SQL skills, including complex data modeling and BigQuery performance optimization

title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Role


You'll join the Reporting & Analytics team at Pride Global — a high-impact, cross-functional group responsible for delivering data-driven insights across our global staffing operations.

This role sits at the center of how the business makes decisions. You’ll be responsible for building the reporting layer that powers executive dashboards, client presentations, and operational insights across the US, Canada, UK, and Brazil.

This is not just a dashboarding role. You’ll translate complex workforce, financial, and market data into clear, actionable narratives used by senior leadership and global business heads.

We need someone who can take ambiguous business questions, structure them into analytical problems, and deliver high-quality reporting solutions end-to-end — from data modeling to final presentation.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and develop Power BI dashboards used in executive-level reporting and client-facing presentations
  • Build self-service reporting solutions that allow business stakeholders to explore data independently
  • Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards optimized for both desktop and mobile consumption
  • Develop and manage Power BI datasets, workspaces, and deployment pipelines across Dev / UAT / Prod
  • Model data using star and snowflake schemas, applying best practices in DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple sources — ATS, VMS/MSP platforms, SQL databases, Excel, SharePoint, and HR/ERP systems
  • Partner with business leaders to understand reporting needs and translate them into structured analytical outputs
  • Present insights and guide stakeholders through dashboards, explaining trends, limitations, and opportunities
  • Support recurring reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly) with accurate and timely delivery
  • Define and standardize key business metrics (headcount, spend, fill rates, aging, profitability, etc.)
  • Implement data quality checks, anomaly detection, and validation rules within reporting layers
  • Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic to ensure long-term scalability and governance


What We’re Looking For

Must have (3–5 years of experience):

  • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, RLS)
  • Solid SQL skills (joins, aggregations, query optimization, working with relational databases)
  • Experience building reporting solutions for operational, workforce, or business performance data
  • Proven ability to design clean, executive-level dashboards with clear storytelling and minimal noise
  • Experience managing Power BI Service (workspaces, refresh schedules, access control, deployments)
  • Ability to translate business needs into analytical solutions and communicate insights effectively
  • Strong English communication skills (you’ll work with global stakeholders daily)


Nice to have:

  • Experience in staffing, workforce, or HR analytics
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud data platforms
  • Basic experience with Python or R for data preparation or automation
  • Exposure to data governance practices (metric standardization, data lineage, documentation)
  • Experience working in cross-functional environments (finance, operations, delivery teams)

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
We are seeking a Customer Service / Sales Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as a key link between our clients, partners, and internal teams. Your primary responsibility will be to help users throughout their experience on our platform, ensuring they can communicate smoothly and receive exceptional service. 


Responsibilities:  

  • Provide frontline support to clients during account registration, identity verification, deposits, withdrawals, and general platform use. 
  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat, email, and phone with professionalism, empathy, and clarity. 
  • Monitor and resolve issues related to account access, transactions, and platform functionality, escalating when necessary. 
  • Collaborate with the sales and operations teams to ensure timely follow-up and a seamless customer experience. 
  • Maintain accurate client and partner information in CRM systems. 
  • Support service campaigns focused on client satisfaction, retention, and community engagement. 
  • Track common questions and issues to help improve internal processes and FAQs. 

Qualifications:  

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service or sales support roles. 
  • Strong communication skills in English (professional level). 
  • Empathetic, patient, and solution-oriented when dealing with customers. 
  • Comfortable using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce). 
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Experience in fintech, digital platforms, or affiliate programs is a plus. 

What We Offer:  

  • Ongoing training and growth opportunities 
  • Supportive team culture 
  • Exposure to a global customer base and a fast-evolving industry 


Job type: Full-Time (Remote) 

Pay: $700USD/month

title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the U.S., powering tens of millions of text and voice conversations every month, helping real estate professionals close more deals.


We’re expanding our Customer Success team and hiring a high-performing Onboarding Specialist. You will own the customers' first 30 - 45 days, set the tone for the relationship, build confidence and ensure customers are ready quickly and correctly. This role defines the customer’s first impression of Smarter Contact and has clear growth potential within a fast-scaling SaaS company. This is a direct-hire role.


What You’ll Own:

  • Lead and follow up on all 1-1 or group onboarding sessions via phone, video, text, and email using our own tech stack
  • Complete all daily CRM tasks (to-dos, emails, texts, calls, etc.)
  • Guide customers through initial setup, configuration, and first live campaigns
  • Establish clear expectations for SMS performance, compliance, and best practices
  • Reinforce Smarter Contact’s value proposition, positioning, and differentiators
  • Ensure customers reach defined activation milestones within the onboarding window
  • Proactively identify confusion, friction, or risk during onboarding-escalate and resolve
  • Document onboarding outcomes, next steps, and handoff notes clearly in CRM
  • Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience to ensure a clean transition post onboarding.
  • Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 AM - 7 pm Eastern Standard Time, Monday to Friday

title: Video Editor — E-commerce Ads
description:
About Us:

We run 3 health brands across the US and EU. By end of 2025 we were doing $50K days with a team of 3. Now we are scaling to $150K days and need editors who want to own their craft.


About the Role:

You will edit video ads for Meta that actually convert. You see the results. You iterate. When your ads win, you get paid for it.


Responsibilities:

- Edit short and long form video ads for Meta

- Source b-roll from TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest

- Create hook variations

- Same day turnarounds on variations


Requirements:

- Experience editing Meta ads for e-commerce

- Understanding of what makes an ad convert - hooks, pacing, visuals

- Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar

- Ability to work independently


Compensation:

- $2,000-$5,000 USD/month base depending on experience

- Performance bonuses up to $500/month per brand for top performing ads

- Full training program provided before you start


Job type: Full-time or Part-time

Schedule: Flexible

Location: Remote

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer

Location: Brazil

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits, candidate responsible for own taxes)

Contract: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Hours: 40 hours per week


About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Data Engineer to join a software-centric data engineering team responsible for building and maintaining high-scale data systems. This role involves owning the end-to-end delivery of complex data infrastructure and high-fidelity integrations.

This is a coding-heavy position requiring strong expertise in building robust integrations between internal microservices and external partner APIs, as well as developing scalable data pipelines. You will collaborate closely with Data Science, Product and Engineering teams to deliver advanced data platform capabilities.


Responsibilities

title: Consulting Partner
description:
ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

title: Data Annotator - Portuguese
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Native proficiency in German language and the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Criador de Conteúdo (Vídeos sobre AEC)
description:
Na Blocks, transformamos o setor de Arquitetura, Engenharia e Construção com soluções inovadoras baseadas no Revit. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional que seja apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, comunicação e tendências do mercado, para ser a cara da Blocks nas redes sociais e na comunidade.



Sobre a Blocks

A Blocks é uma empresa de tecnologia, possui um software próprio e se dedica a digitalizar produtos reais em modelos 3D de alta qualidade, fornecendo ferramentas essenciais para otimizar os processos de trabalho de arquitetos, engenheiros e designers de interiores ao redor do mundo.


️ O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser a voz e o rosto da Blocks em vídeos, tutoriais e conteúdos técnicos;
  • Produzir e gravar vídeos sobre o plugin para Revit, mostrando como eles otimizam processos no setor;
  • Falar sobre tendências de mercado e tecnologia no nosso setor, conectando o público com as novidades do momento;
  • Criar conteúdos criativos e envolventes, alinhados com a identidade da Blocks;
  • Interagir com a comunidade online, promovendo engajamento e respondendo a perguntas sobre nossos produtos e temas relacionados.
  • Auxílio em criação dos roteiros e materiais desenvolvidos
  • Auxiliar o time de marketing em outras funcões necessárias.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação completa ou em andamento na área de arquitetura, designer de interiores ou áreas afins
  • Experiência com redes sociais e estratégias de conteúdo digital 
  • Habilidade em comunicação escrita e verbal 
  • Experiência com criação de vídeos 
  • Ser criativo(a) 
  • Conhecimento no plugin da Blocks (diferencial)
  • Conhecimento no software Revit (diferencial) 


  O que oferecemos:

  • Remuneração: R$ 3.000,00 (CLT)
  • Half-day Fridays – termine sua sexta-feira mais cedo.
  • Trabalho 100% Home Office – com escritório virtual.
  • Plano de saúde com subsídio.
  • Vale alimentação via iFood, no valor de R$31,00 por dia útil.
  • Seguro de vida sem custo ao colaborador. 
  • Auxílio educação para cursos, eventos e livros da área profissionalizante.
  • Auxílio creche para pais e mães com filhos até 4 anos de idade.
  • Wellhub: acesso a academias e estúdios 
  • Bem-estar com Avus e Starbem: atendimento psicológico, médico e outros serviços de saúde.
  • Parceria com o SESC: descontos em eventos e serviços.
  • Day off no mês do aniversário, para você comemorar como quiser!

title: UX/UI Designer Pleno
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Ensino superior completo em Web Design, Design Gráfico, com ênfase em Digital, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência em Design de Interface UI e UX.

Experiência com levantamento e análise de requisitos.

Conhecimento em HTML, CSS e JS.

Experiência com prototipação, utilizando Figma, Adobe XD ou similares.

Certificações em UX/UI.

Portfólio de protótipos e exemplos de automações desenvolvidas.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Product Engineering)

Location: Brazil (100% remote)

Contract: PJ – Long Term


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

You will collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineering leadership to deliver reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems that directly influence key business initiatives.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and internal tooling
  • Contribute to user-facing applications that support listing, enrichment, and merchandising workflows
  • Write clean, performant, and testable code in a production environment
  • Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the platform
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering stakeholders
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers
  • Pair program and support team collaboration and onboarding
  • Deploy code to production with a strong focus on reliability and quality
  • Leverage observability tools, metrics, and incident learnings to improve system performance and stability


Tech Stack

Java, Kotlin, Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, DynamoDB


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Experience building production-ready, scalable, and secure systems
  • Solid understanding of backend development and modern web applications
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, and common development tools
  • Experience or interest in JVM-based services (Java/Kotlin)
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Knowledge of database fundamentals and API design (GraphQL or similar)
  • Passion for testing, code quality, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to contribute to technical direction and architectural decisions
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with JVM services in production environments
  • Experience with modern frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS)
  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI APIs into applications or internal tools
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems
  • Background in eCommerce platforms
  • Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., Prismic)
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response

description:
Vaga para professor(a) de inglês online – The Fluency Club


Estamos em busca de novos professores para integrar o nosso time!

O The Fluency Club é uma escola de inglês 100% online, especializada em aulas particulares e em pequenos grupos (até 4 alunos), com foco em fluência e personalização para adultos de todos os níveis.

Procuramos profissionais com experiência no ensino de inglês, boa comunicação, responsabilidade, comprometimento e disposição para crescer com a gente. Valorizamos pessoas abertas ao aprendizado contínuo e a receber feedback com leveza e profissionalismo. Como nossa escola é online, nossos professores podem trabalhar de qualquer lugar pois a vaga é para trabalho 100% remoto.


Requisitos da vaga:

  • Disponibilidade mínima de 15 horas semanais (preferencialmente manhã e noite)
  • Experiência prévia com ensino de inglês
  • Contratação PJ (necessário ter ou abrir MEI)
  • Bom funcionamento de computador, microfone e internet
  • Nível de inglês mínimo: B2+


Mais informações sobre a vaga — incluindo valor da hora/aula, pré-requisitos e orientações sobre o processo seletivo — estão disponíveis no formulário.


Se você se identificou, preencha o formulário no link abaixo.

Entraremos em contato com os candidatos selecionados para participação no processo seletivo.


Thank you!

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Company Description

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company dedicated to delivering exceptional results in its field. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, Fabri Holdings emphasizes fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment. The company values individuals who are highly organized, solutions-focused, and eager to contribute to its ongoing success. Fabri Holdings provides an opportunity to grow in a supportive and challenging professional setting.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for an Executive Assistant. The Executive Assistant will provide high-level administrative support to executives, including managing schedules, preparing expense reports, organizing meetings, and maintaining key communication within the organization. Other responsibilities include handling sensitive information with confidentiality, coordinating projects, and ensuring the seamless execution of day-to-day administrative tasks.


Qualifications

  • Strong skills in Executive Administrative Assistance and Administrative Assistance to manage schedules, meetings, and daily operations.
  • Proficiency in handling Expense Reports and supporting executives with financial documentation and reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience in Executive Support, including project coordination and maintaining confidentiality.
  • Outstanding Communication skills, both verbal and written, to streamline internal and external interactions.
  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in productivity tools such as Microsoft Office Suite, scheduling software, and communication platforms.
  • Previous experience supporting C-suite executives is a plus.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist


About Us:

We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it’s grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutions


The Role:

We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you’re excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.


What You’ll Do:

  • Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience
  • Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner
  • Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships; conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios
  • Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus
  • Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client’s mission
  • Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery
  • Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results
  • Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processes


What we are looking for:

  • Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles
  • Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America
  • Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcing


Who You Are:

  • Someone who is not satisfied with “just good enough” and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate
  • A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others
  • Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese


Are You Still Curious?

If you’ve read this far, then chances are you’ve got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can’t wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

title: 3D Product Rendering Artist (Freelance)
description:
Are you looking to work for an innovative and exciting company from Silicon Valley or New York, 100% remotely?

We are looking for multi-skilled candidates with excellent creative and execution skills for the position of Product Render Expert (Freelance).

We are seeking highly talented Render Experts who can create high-quality, visually compelling product renders and animations for eCommerce, landing pages, and paid media. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, motion, lighting, and storytelling, and is able to take minimal direction and turn it into premium, production-ready visuals.


This role is project-based, with opportunities to collaborate in ongoing creative sprints. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and delivering high-quality work under limited guidance.

The compensation range is $5 to $20 USD per hour , depending on the candidate’s experience and quality of work.


Candidates from Latin America are highly encouraged to apply.

Candidates in a time zone outside of the western hemisphere will NOT be considered.

The role is 100% remote.

ALL RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH


Responsibilities:

  • Create high-quality product renders and short animations for web, social media, and paid advertising
  • Produce clean, modern, and premium visuals with strong attention to detail
  • Work with minimal direction to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling
  • Execute lighting, materials, and composition that enhance product appeal
  • Develop looping animations (5–10 seconds) suitable for digital platforms
  • Adapt renders across different backgrounds and formats
  • Collaborate in short creative sprints (audit + initial concepts + execution)
  • Continuously iterate and improve assets based on feedback


Requirements:

  • Proven experience creating high-quality product renders (portfolio required)
  • Strong skills in 3D rendering, lighting, materials, and composition
  • Experience with animation and motion design (looping animations preferred)
  • Ability to create realistic and visually appealing product imagery
  • Strong sense of modern design, aesthetics, and visual storytelling
  • Ability to work independently with limited direction
  • Experience working on eCommerce, branding, or paid media content
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on execution quality
  • Comfortable working on short, fast-paced projects (sprint-based work)


Assessment (Required):

As part of the process, candidates will complete a short render challenge designed to evaluate:

  • Product realism and material quality
  • Motion and animation quality
  • Creative thinking and execution
  • Attention to detail and overall design taste

This assignment is intended to be brief (~2 hours) and focuses on showcasing your approach and skills.


English Requirement:

Fluent in English — YOU MUST BE ABLE TO HAVE A FLUENT PROFESSIONAL CONVERSATION IN ENGLISH

title: AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.


The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\"does this surface the right principal investigator?\") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.


Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Data Annotator
description:
Who is Blueprint Technologies?

We are a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with a strong presence across the United States and an expanding footprint across Latin America (LATAM). Our teams are united by a shared passion for solving complex problems.


At Blueprint, we use technology as a bridge between strategy and execution. Our people bring diverse perspectives, deep expertise, and real-world experience across industries to help organizations grow, transform, and innovate.


About the Role

We are seeking detail-oriented Labelers / Annotators to evaluate responses generated by AI systems across multiple languages .


This role focuses on side-by-side (SBS) evaluation of outputs from different AI models across real-world scenarios. You will play a key role in improving how AI systems understand and communicate across languages and cultures.


This is not a translation role . It is an evaluation and analysis role requiring strong judgment and attention to detail.


Language Requirement

Fluency in English + at least one of the following languages:

  • Chinese (Simplified and/or Traditional)
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Italian
  • German
  • French


What You’ll Work On

You will evaluate AI responses across scenarios such as:

  • General-purpose Q&A
  • Web search results
  • File-based and image-based responses
  • Image and file generation tasks
  • Single-turn and multi-turn conversations


Responsibilities

  • Perform side-by-side (SBS) comparisons of AI-generated responses
  • Evaluate outputs based on:
  • Accuracy
  • Relevance
  • Clarity
  • Instruction-following
  • Identify nuances in tone, meaning, and cultural context across languages
  • Apply detailed, scenario-specific annotation guidelines
  • Maintain consistency and high-quality evaluations


Required Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in English + at least one target language listed above
  • Prior experience with side-by-side (SBS) labeling or annotation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
  • Ability to quickly understand and apply structured evaluation frameworks


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in linguistics, translation, or localization
  • Experience in:
  • AI evaluation
  • Data annotation
  • Search relevance or content quality analysis


Compensation

We offer competitive compensation aligned with local markets and experience.

Estimated hourly range: R$75 – R$85 BRL

Estimated monthly equivalent (full-time): R$12,000 – R$13,600 BRL

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity.


Training & Qualification

All new hires will complete a structured onboarding program, including:

  • Training sessions and practice exercises
  • Calibration against quality benchmarks
  • Qualification review before moving into production work


Benefits & Employment Structure

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner, ensuring full compliance with local labor laws and payroll requirements.

Employees receive locally compliant benefits, which may include:

  • Statutory benefits (e.g., paid leave, 13th salary where applicable)
  • Social security and healthcare contributions
  • Additional benefits aligned with local market practices


Why Blueprint?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI systems
  • Be part of a global, multilingual team
  • Build highly transferable AI evaluation skills
  • Contribute directly to improving real-world AI experiences


Equal Opportunity Employer

Blueprint Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, or any other protected status.

title: PMO #1003033
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que você precisa ter?

Procuramos por PMO para gerenciar e liderar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão projetos de dados, garantindo a orquestração entre squads, stakeholders e áreas de negócio, com foco em governança, arquitetura, engenharia e produtos de dados. É esperado que você combine a disciplina da gestão clássica de projetos com práticas ágeis modernas, dominando ferramentas e metodologias de ponta.


Requisitos:

  • Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos.
  • Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto).
  • Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente.
  • Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live).
  • Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional).
  • Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável.
  • Liderança: Capacidade de coordenar múltiplos times e níveis organizacionais com clareza, empatia e foco em resultado.
  • Comunicação executiva: Consegue transitar bem entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, ajustando linguagem e reportes.
  • Visão de produto e entrega: Compreende o ciclo completo de soluções de dados – da engenharia à aplicação no negócio.
  • Autonomia e ownership: Alta capacidade de autogestão, priorização e tomada de decisão em ambientes ambíguos.
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis
  • Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem).
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase.
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project.
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2).
  • Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven).
  • Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis.
  • Inglês fluente (Necessário para comunicação).


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Atuar como liderança técnica e referência na visão de cliente e negócio, fortalecendo o relacionamento com stakeholders internos e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time.
  • Ter forte orientação a negócio, compreendendo operações, métricas e processos para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o atingimento de metas.
  • Disseminar conhecimento por meio de documentação clara e comunicação efetiva entre pares e áreas.
  • Demonstrar atitude de dono, aplicando boas práticas em processos, tecnologias e entregas, com foco em resultados.
  • Atuar como interface entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia, conduzindo escopos de curto, médio e longo prazo com comunicação clara e assertiva.
  • Gerenciar projetos e programas de dados com múltiplas squads e alto nível de complexidade técnica e funcional.
  • Planejar e acompanhar roadmaps, cronogramas e marcos, garantindo previsibilidade das entregas.
  • Garantir business readiness, coordenando comunicação, treinamentos, documentação e alinhamentos necessários.
  • Facilitar rituais ágeis quando aplicável (Planning, Review, Retrospective).
  • Orquestrar dependências entre times de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança.
  • Estabelecer rotinas de comunicação e reportes com stakeholders, acompanhando indicadores e progresso.
  • Organizar entregáveis finais como go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.


Local de atuação: No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer)
description:
#Conheça um pouco sobre a área:


O propósito da squad SRE Cloud Data é implementar e administrar a infraestrutura cloud AWS responsável pela hospedagem dos bancos de dados, conectividade entre os serviços e stack de monitoramento/observabilidade utilizada na operação das nossas plataformas de GeoLocation , Go To Market Intelligence e de Reputação e Comunicação , utilizando estratégias de implementação de IAC, com confiabilidade e resiliência, apoiando as squads de desenvolvimento na operação e promovendo a cultura DevOps.


Nosso maior desafio é implementar, operar e monitorar a infraestrutura de forma escalável, com eficiência operacional e de custo, desenvolvendo automações para otimização do trabalho de SRE e provendo autonomia para os squads de engenharia.


#Desafios que você vai encontrar:

  • Gerenciar, administrar e evoluir ambientes de bancos de dados em produção e não-produção utilizando IAC
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade dos bancos de dados
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de backup, restore, replicação e disaster recovery
  • Atuar em tuning, capacity planning e troubleshooting de bancos e integrações de dados
  • Atuar em incidentes, realizando RCA (Root Cause Analysis) e ações preventivas
  • Criar e manter runbooks e documentação de padrões
  • Garantir conectividade eficiente, segura e resiliente entre aplicações e bancos de dados na AWS
  • Atuar no planejamento, administração e otimização de custo dos recursos de rede na AWS (VPCs, Subnets, Route Tables, NAT Gateway, VPC Peering, VPC Endpoints, Transit Gateway, VPN etc)
  • Participar ativamente de diagnósticos de problemas de latência, perda de pacotes, timeouts e falhas de conexão
  • Trabalhar com IAM e políticas de acesso a recursos
  • Definir e acompanhar SLIs e SLOs para bancos de dados e padrões para monitoramento e observabilidade
  • Atuar com ferramentas como Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • Apoiar estratégias de observabilidade orientada a confiabilidade


✔️ #Conhecimentos importantes para a posição:

  • Experiência prévia como DBRE em ambientes críticos de produção
  • Conhecimento sólido de implementação, escala, tuning e disaster recovery em ao menos dois dos seguintes bancos de dados: PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, SOLR, MongoDB, Oracle e Snowflake
  • Forte experiência com AWS, incluindo serviços de rede, conectividade, monitoramento e observabilidade
  • Conhecimento prático de Terraform (infraestrutura de bancos e rede como código)
  • Domínio dos conceitos de redes: TCP/IP, DNS, latência, throughput, timeouts
  • Automação com Shell, Python ou similares
  • Experiência com monitoramento, métricas e alertas de bancos de dados
  • Vivência em ambientes SRE/DevOps e atuação em incidentes de produção
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting complexo (banco + rede + aplicação)
  • Experiência com EKS/Kubernetes integrando aplicações e bancos de dados


⭐ #Diferencial para a posição:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Elastic Stack (shards, índices, ILM, tuning)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade
  • Mentalidade focada em redução de toil, automação e confiabilidade sistêmica


#PraVocê Nossos Beneficios:

PraVocê no dia a dia :

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação;
  • Gympass/TotalPass;
  • Auxílio home-office;


PraVocê & Família :

  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Odontológico (odonto é opcional);
  • Auxílio creche (até os 6 anos completos da criança):
  • Licença-Maternidade, Paternidade e Adotante Estendidas (#todasasfamíliasimportam);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Day Off de Aniversário (Um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário.);
  • Dia da Família (Um dia de folga para mamães e papais tirarem entre os meses de maio e agosto e aproveitar como quiserem.);
  • Pausa Mental (Uma semana corrida de folga em dezembro para que descansem e recarreguem as baterias.

*Benefícios de acordo com a política vigente*


PraVocê AINDA MAIS :

● Senso de propósito ao fazer parte de um time que está construindo algo que será perene e trará frutos para a sociedade, seja a Cortex em si enquanto \"startup\" em rápido crescimento que gerará cada vez mais empregos, seja o produto Plataforma Cortex, que será usado por cada vez mais usuários no Brasil e exterior.

● Ambiente de trabalho descontraído, jovem, empreendedor e meritocrático, sem espaço para política.. ;-)

● Oportunidade de desenvolvimento de carreira e crescimento numa empresa que não para de crescer.


Valorizamos, cultivamos e respeitamos as diferenças, por isso proporcionamos um ambiente aberto e inclusivo.

Todas as nossas posições são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência.
